study.question: Observation: the current fixed-seed incumbent has click AUC0.6671356857671729 and model-only batch p50/p95 15.8069506/15.9136161ms, with32108245 parameters. Its real-arithmetic affine MAC reduction did not proportionally reduce full inference wall time (27.6391s versus28.1381s original); no operator profile is available. The inspected pinned Dice implementation still materializes p*x,1-p,alpha*(1-p),alpha*(1-p)*x and their sum. Can factoring this evaluation mixture at the scorer and/or task towers preserve click AUC and measurably reduce prediction cost without reducing capacity or changing training?
study.hypothesis: Provisional implementation hypothesis: at fixed parameters and frozen BatchNorm state, x*(alpha+p*(1-alpha)) retains the Dice function over real arithmetic while a broadcast addcmul plus final multiplication reduces large elementwise intermediates. The scorer location touches2880 hidden activation elements/example versus768 across the towers, suggesting a larger potential effect at the scorer if memory traffic or eager operation overhead is consequential. This is source-derived, not a measured bottleneck. Broad reductions previously failed (embedding12 AUC0.66411118, scorer_half0.66543686); residual width8 preserved quality approximately but timing remained unresolved, and subsequent allocation14/10 reached0.66712494. Auxiliary shared projection0.66482487 failed; the initialization factorial showed donor initialization was a major confound, so that failure does not establish the impossibility of useful sharing. The latest affine suite preserved quality but gives only single-seed, noisy timing evidence. This proposal tests operational cost of the supported representation; it does not claim reduced capacity or architectural novelty. Freeze before host screening: absolute click-AUC noninferiority margin0.0002. Require candidate-minus-contemporaneous-reference >= -0.0002 AND candidate AUC >= 0.6669356857671729 (frozen current incumbent0.6671356857671729 minus0.0002). Also report against imported joint entry0.666753547526167 and DIN0.6555440824200336 as historical utility references, not contemporaneous controls. Reference AUC must match parent within0.000002 and host state/parameter checks must pass; otherwise suspend causal interpretation and diagnose drift. A provisional cost success requires at least2% lower model-only batch p50 versus the same-suite reference, p95 no more than1% higher, and full-validation inference wall time no more than3% higher. No training-time, total-parameter or embedding-memory reduction is predicted or claimed. Report all four task AUC/Logloss, slices with sample/positive/negative counts (negatives=samples-positives), mean AUC separately, measured parameters, training/wall/inference seconds, peak GPU memory and throughput. All slice comparisons are exploratory, use inherited fixed bins, and insufficient-class slices are marked unavailable. Eligible variant selection: lowest p50, then p95, then higher click AUC; differences require repeated cost checks before a deployment-speed claim. AUC gain from altered BF16 rounding alone is not evidence of representation improvement or new information.
